name: SA-Solver
plain: Stochastic Adams predictor-corrector: uses a window of past x0 predictions with coefficients from exponential integrals, and noise only inside a chosen band of σ. One model call per step, because the corrector reuses the prediction at the predicted state. The node lets the band and orders be set.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
tau: τ(σ)=η if start_σ≥σ≥end_σ else 0; default start=percent_to_sigma(0.2), end=percent_to_sigma(0.8), η=1.
Predictor toward σ': b from solving a Vandermonde system in λ over the exponential integrals (compute_exponential_coeffs), scaled by α'; x_p=(σ'/σ)e^{−τ²h}x+Σb_kD_k; noise e=n·σ'√(1−e^{−2τ²h})·s_noise; x_p+=e.
Corrector at current i: x=(σ/σ_{i−1})e^{−τ²h}x+Σb_kD_k (includes D at x_p)+e reused from the predictor. Corrector is skipped at i=0, and at σ'=0 unless PECE.
Orders: predictor default 3, corrector default 4; limited by history, and lowered toward the end if the schedule ends in 0.

props.final_sigma0: Explicit: σ'=0 sets x_pred=D, returned as the result, after the last evaluation.
props.flow_const: half-logSNR via sigma_to_half_log_snr: λ=−log σ normally, λ=log((1−σ)/σ) on CONST; α=σe^{λ} (1 normally, 1−σ on CONST). First σ≥1 on CONST replaced by percent_to_sigma(1e-4); s_noise×noise_scale.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Node exposes eta, sde_start_percent, sde_end_percent, s_noise, predictor_order, corrector_order, use_pece, simple_order_2.

label: from code
surprise: Corrected state is not re-evaluated in non-PECE mode: the corrector reuses the predictor's noise draw, and D at x_p serves both correction and next prediction.
